question: Which of the following is an example of temperate and subtropical crop?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Wheat**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Wheat** is a temperate and subtropical crop that thrives in moderate climates, with an ideal temperature range of **10°C to 15°C** during sowing and **21°C to 26°C** during harvesting.
 
• It is predominantly grown in regions with **low to moderate rainfall** (annual precipitation of **30-100 cm**), making it suitable for temperate and subtropical climates.
 
• Major wheat-producing countries include **China, India, USA, Russia, and France**. In India, it is cultivated extensively in the **northern plains**, particularly in states like **Punjab, Haryana, Uttar Pradesh, and Madhya Pradesh**.
 
• Wheat serves as a staple food crop globally, primarily used to produce **flour, bread, pasta, and other bakery products**.
 
• The crop requires well-drained loamy soil and is typically grown during the **Rabi season** in India, where it is sown in October-November and harvested in March-April.
